get.summary: List the material saved for catalogued Sign-in Methods.
get.description: One item per catalogued method with material saved: subscriptions from the Operator's own Profiles, keys from the Organization's Provider Credentials. A key two harnesses offer appears once for each, sharing its revision and authentication evidence but never its model-use evidence. An empty slot is absent; the harness catalogue describes what could be saved. Nothing read here is the material, a hash of it, a login file or a provider's own words.

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: The name of the Organization the records belong to.

200.description: Every catalogued method with material saved, in catalogue order.

put.summary: Save material for a catalogued Sign-in Method.
put.description: A subscription is held in the Operator's own Profile, declared after the Operator when they have none; a key is held as the Organization's Provider Credential the method fills. Nobody is asked which. The value is checked for shape before anything is stored, and a key whose provider documents an authenticated model-metadata read is checked that way, bounded to ten seconds; nothing ever spends model usage. A provider refusing the key itself is 422 and keeps what was saved before; a refusal about permission, credit or another matter saves the key unchecked. A provider that cannot be asked, times out or limits the rate saves it unchecked and answers 503 carrying what was saved. Material replaced while this was being checked is 409, and the replacement stands.

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: The name of the Organization the records belong to.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: One of that harness's Sign-in Method ids.

200.description: Saved, with whatever authentication evidence its check established.

post.summary: Test saved material with one model call.
post.description: Starts an explicit test of the material saved for a catalogued Sign-in Method and answers before it runs; read the test by its id for how it went. It spends model usage: one prompt asking for a one-word reply, sent once and never retried, by the harness in a short-lived Instance of the configured image that has no checkout, belongs to no Workspace and is handed only the selected material. Saving never does this. With no `model` the harness's own default is tested and reported; a method listing `test_providers` requires a `model` whose provider is one of them, and only that provider is enabled. The image is inspected first and never pulled: a harness it does not carry is 409 and an image that cannot be inspected 503. Nothing saved is 409 `sign_in_not_saved`. A subscription already in use by a Session of a serialized harness, or by another test, is 409 `credential_in_use`; the test is not queued behind it.

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: The name of the Organization the records belong to.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: One of that harness's Sign-in Method ids.

202.description: The test was accepted and is pending.

get.summary: Read how a test of saved material went.
get.description: Answers 200 whatever the test found: a failed, timed-out or interrupted test is a successful read. Reading never starts, repeats or extends the test, so a Client that lost its connection reads the id it was given.

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: The name of the Organization the records belong to.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: One of that harness's Sign-in Method ids.

parameters.name: test
parameters.description: The id a started test answered with.
